unit: EUR bn, calendar years; values are each item's effect on borrowing (+ adds), or for a spending plan its level

items.label: Defence ramp (NATO definition)
items.head: spend
items.event: Finanzplan 2026-2030 (cabinet 6 July 2026); defence exempt from the debt rule (Art. 109/115 GG, March 2025)
items.source: Finanzplan 2026-2030: federal defence spending on the NATO definition (Einzelplan 14, Sondervermögen Bundeswehr and other defence items), as charted in KfW Research, Chartbook Bundeshaushalt, August 2026

items.label: Infrastructure special fund (SVIK)
items.head: spend
items.source: Regierungsentwurf 2027 and Finanzplan to 2030, SVIK outflows as reported by the Bundestag (hib 553/2026). Held flat in money in the model's base (the special funds run at their run-rate), so not grown

items.label: Investment tax programme (depreciation, corporate tax cut)
items.head: tax
items.source: Bundestag Haushaltsausschuss report BT-Drs. 21/643 (the law as adopted): federal (Bund) revenue loss, cash years

items.label: Compensating municipalities for the tax programme (VAT share)
items.head: tax
items.event: FAG-Änderungsgesetz 2025 (municipal VAT fixed amounts raised, borne by the Bund)
items.source: Bundestag Haushaltsausschuss report BT-Drs. 21/2253 on the FAG amendment (BT-Drs. 21/1892): the Bund's VAT loss from compensating municipalities, 13,539m over 2025-2029

items.label: Mütterrente III (Bund tax-financed grant)
items.head: spend
items.event: Rentenpaket 2025 / Mütterrente III (in force 1 Jan 2027; first payments 2028 with 2027 back-pay)
items.source: Deutsche Rentenversicherung: ~€5bn a year from tax-financed Bund grant. 2028 carries 2027 arrears (~€10bn that year); thereafter ~€5bn. Bundesrechnungshof confirms the same order of magnitude
